title: How to write ChatGPT prompts that get usable work
seoTitle: How to write ChatGPT prompts for work
description: How to write ChatGPT prompts that give usable work: six parts, before-and-after examples, a reusable template and tips for Claude and Gemini too.
lede: To write ChatGPT prompts that produce usable work, brief your AI the way you would brief a capable new assistant. Give it a role, the context, one task, your material, the format and the checks to run. This guide explains each part, with practical examples, a real business example and a reusable template.
